headwords: phong ba bão táp không bằng ngữ pháp Việt Nam

flags.why: The example explains what the word means instead of using it to refer to a fork.
flags.fix: Ông dùng phuốc-sét để ăn. = He used a fork to eat.

flags.why: This is a derogatory label for a child who ruins the family fortune, as confirmed by [VOH](https://voh.com.vn/song-dep/y-nghia-cau-noi-pha-gia-chi-tu-la-gi-545114.html), but it lacks a warning tag.
